description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Claude is available to enterprises through Microsoft Foundry, and the Microsoft partnership has become one of our most important paths to market. Many of the largest enterprises in financial services, healthcare and life sciences, and the public sector buy Microsoft first, and we want Claude to be the obvious choice when they do.

As Partner Manager for Microsoft Co-Sell, you will turn that partnership into pipeline and closed revenue. You will build and run joint sales plays with Microsoft's field organization, connect Anthropic account executives with their Microsoft counterparts on shared target accounts, and make sure deals that start in a co-sell conversation actually close through Azure Marketplace. You will own your work end to end, from the details of a single stuck deal to the executive readout on how the partnership is performing.

• Give Anthropic and Microsoft leaders a clear view of what is working and what is blocked

• Experience owning a revenue or pipeline number through a partner or co-sell motion, with results you can point to

• Working knowledge of how enterprise deals transact through a cloud marketplace, including hands-on experience unblocking stuck deals

• Strong attention to detail and operational rigor, with the ability to turn that detail into a clear, concise story for executives

• A record of taking full ownership of your work: closing loops and keeping stakeholders informed proactively

• Ability to keep a stalled deal or program moving through repeated blockers until it is resolved

• Ability to build trust across a large, matrixed partner organization, with field sellers and their leaders alike

Preferred qualifications

• Experience selling or partnering around AI, ML, or developer platform products

title: Scrum Master – Agile & SAFe Methodology (PL6292)
description:
Location: Fully Remote from India
Employment Type: Long-Term Contract
Shift: 2.00 PM - 11.00 PM IST
About Paralucent
Paralucent brings clarity to complex work, helping organisations move beyond complexity towards clarity through practical, thoughtful technology solutions.

Paralucent Core Values
We’re Driven to deliver real outcomes, and we Take Ownership from first question to final result. We’re Creative Problem Solvers who cut through complexity to bring clarity, and we’re Humbly Confident, with high standards, low ego and a commitment to continuous learning. Above all, we’re Customer Centric: we build with empathy, partner closely, and measure success by the impact we create for the people who rely on what we deliver.
Why This Role Matters
You will enable Agile delivery teams to work predictably, collaboratively and with a clear focus on value. As an experienced Scrum Master, you will facilitate Scrum ceremonies, remove delivery impediments and support continuous improvement in a SAFe environment. You will partner closely with Product Owners, Release Train Engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen team maturity, align delivery to programme objectives and help teams deliver meaningful outcomes.
Requirements
Key Responsibilities:

• Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews and retrospectives.

• Coach delivery teams on Scrum, Agile principles and SAFe practices to improve delivery predictability and team maturity.

• Support Programme Increment planning, including dependency management, risk identification and alignment to programme objectives.

• Partner with Product Owners to maintain healthy, prioritised product backlogs and clearly defined user stories.

• Identify, track and remove impediments affecting team performance or delivery timelines.

• Monitor and communicate delivery health, including sprint progress, velocity, capacity, risks, dependencies and delivery metrics.

• Drive continuous improvement through actionable retrospectives and measurable process enhancements.

• Strengthen collaboration across development, QA, product, architecture and business teams.

• Maintain Agile delivery artefacts in Azure DevOps, including boards, dashboards, reports and work item tracking.

Qualifications:

• 5+ years of experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Coach or in a related Agile delivery role.

• Strong experience applying Scrum and Agile delivery practices within software or technology teams.

• Experience working in a SAFe environment, including Programme Increment planning and cross-team dependency management.

• Hands-on Azure DevOps experience, including backlog management, sprint boards, dashboards, queries, reporting and work item tracking.

• Demonstrated ability to facilitate meetings, resolve impediments and guide teams through change.

• Strong communication, stakeholder management and conflict resolution skills.

• Experience partnering with Product Owners and technical teams to improve backlog readiness and sprint execution.

Nice to Have

• Scrum Master certification, such as PSM, CSM or SAFe Scrum Master.

• SAFe certification, such as SAFe Agilist or SAFe Scrum Master.

• Experience supporting multiple Agile teams or Agile Release Trains.

• Familiarity with Agile metrics, including velocity, burndown or burnup, cycle time, lead time and predictability.

• Experience supporting enterprise software delivery, DevOps, cloud or digital transformation programmes.

If you want to do work you’re proud of, with people who own the outcome, this is your place.

title: Infrastructure Engineer (m/f/d) - IT Infrastructure Services
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

We're looking for a motivated and driven IT Infrastructure Engineer (m/f/d) who will help us shape our team, drive the company to the next level, and have a direct influence on our success.

As an IT Infrastructure Engineer, you lead the efforts of maintaining and improving our global identity and access management platform as a coherent set of highly available services following our cloud-focused strategy. It is your responsibility to identify improvement opportunities, drive identity projects, and build a unified, scalable environment.

Based in Germany and the US, our IT Infrastructure Services team designs, implements, and manages global cloud and on-premises infrastructure solutions to provide Flix with internal business services such as identity and access management, security and compliance configuration, communication tools, file sharing, 3rd-level support, and infrastructure consulting.

About the Role

• Integrate new internal and external applications into our identity infrastructure (e.g., SSO ) following best practices

• Work on projects to improve internal role-based access control concepts

• Consult other teams and guide them to success, leveraging our services especially regarding identity and access management

• Drive innovation and improve our services together with the team

• Automate recurring tasks

• Design the future IT infrastructure of Flix

About You

• At least 3 years of experience with Microsoft Entra ID or similar identity and access management platforms

• Advanced knowledge of modern authentication protocols ( OIDC , OAuth 2.0, and SAML )

• At least 3 years of scripting experience (ideally with Python)

• At least 1 year of experience with IaC solutions (preferably Terraform)

• Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools to streamline infrastructure automation, troubleshooting, and daily operations

• Basic experience using APIs

• Experience with containerization and orchestration platforms (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus

• Experience working with IaaS solutions is a plus

• Basic knowledge of modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React) or web technologies is a plus

• Experience with M365 products (such as Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams) is a plus

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

• Travel perks : 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 

• Work from (M)Anywhere : Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 

• Hybrid work model : We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 

• Wellbeing support : Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 

• Learning & Development : Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 

• Mentoring Program : Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link:   Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Senior Software Engineer - Planner GPU Compute
description:

In order to ensure safe operation, low latency and consistent resource utilization are critical. The Planner Compute team is responsible for the performance of the largest single software component within the autonomy stack, the motion planner.

The scope for GPU usage ranges from machine learning inference to custom CUDA kernels written specifically for the motion planner.

There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position.

title: Software Engineer - Postgres

To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

The Snowflake Postgres team is building a managed Postgres experience inside Snowflake. This role is focused on the control plane, where you have the opportunity to work on both on distributed systems at scale and also to work on research grade optimizations at various layers of the software stack including but not limited to provisioning, managing, securing, and operating Postgres in Snowflake. You will work on core backend systems that sit at the intersection of distributed systems, database infrastructure, security, and operational excellence.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Design and build backend services that power provisioning, lifecycle management, and configuration of Snowflake Postgres instances.

- Develop features in the access and user model, including authorization, secure administration flows, and customer-facing management capabilities.

- Improve the reliability, observability, and operability of asynchronous workflows and background systems that keep the service healthy.

- Partner with product, security, and adjacent engineering teams to deliver simple customer experiences on top of complex infrastructure.

- Investigate production issues, participate in on-call, and drive fixes that improve resilience and reduce operational burden.

- Contribute to technical design, code review, and mentoring while helping raise the engineering bar across the team.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

- 2+ years of experience building production software in backend, infrastructure, or distributed systems environments.

- Strong programming skills in one or more of Java, Go, C++, or Python.

- Strong computer science fundamentals, including concurrency, networking, APIs, and data structures.

- Experience designing and operating reliable services in production, including debugging, monitoring, and incident response.

- Experience working across technical boundaries with product, security, and other engineering teams.

- BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

NICE TO HAVE:

- Experience with PostgreSQL, database internals, or managed database platforms.

- Experience with identity, authorization, RBAC, or other security-sensitive systems.

- Experience with cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or GCP.

- Experience with workflow orchestration, control plane systems, or highly asynchronous service architectures.

WHY JOIN THIS TEAM?

- Work on a strategic product area that expands Snowflake into transactional and operational database workloads

- Build systems that directly shape how customers create, manage, and secure Postgres inside Snowflake

- Tackle a mix of product engineering, infrastructure, reliability, and security problems.

- Join a collaborative team with meaningful ownership, strong technical challenges, and room to grow

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Training - CA
description:
Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week
Check out this Loom video for more details:
We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.
This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.
What this role actually is
You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:
• Whether the response makes sense

• Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful

• Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment

• Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.
What you'll be doing

• Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end

• Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think

• Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code

• Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)

• Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading

• Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"
We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

• Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?

• Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?

• Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?

• Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.
Who you are

• Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)

• Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python

• Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor

• Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows

• Able to evaluate code without executing it or reviewing every line

• Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement

• Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback

• High bar for what good engineering looks like

Nice to have

• Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows

• Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement details

• Rate: $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location

• Hours: 10-20 hours/week, flexible

• Duration: ongoing. Projects run from about two weeks to a few months each, and we offer new ones to evaluators who do well

• Start: as soon as you clear the take-home and a project has an open seat

• Process: one take-home evaluation exercise with a recorded Loom walkthrough. No interview

title: Creative Strategist / Direct-Response Copywriter - Meta Ads (m/w/d)
description:
Rund 500.000 € Ad-Spend im Monat. Und du konzeptionierst die Videos, die den Account tragen.
Valkental entwickelt seit 2020 Outdoorprodukte für mehr Sicherheit und Komfort im Straßenverkehr. Über 400.000 Kunden vertrauen bereits auf uns. Unser Shop ist achtstellig. Deine Creatives sollen ihn auf dem Weg zu einem neunstelligen supporten.
Aktuell schreibt eine Creative Strategist unsere Ads. Du kommst als zweite Kraft dazu: mit eigener Pipeline, eigenen Ideen und eigenen Ergebnissen. Vollzeit, 100 % remote und mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung.
Aufgaben
Kurzfassung: Du findest heraus, warum Menschen kaufen, und schreibst Videos, die genau das auslösen. Bis zum fertigen Creative im Account.

• Du sammelst Angles: aus Bewertungen, Kommentaren, Umfragen, unseren besten Ads und Swipes. KI hilft beim Research, den Gedanken dahinter hast du.

• Du schreibst komplette Skripte für Video-Ads: Hook, Body, CTA. Auf Deutsch (bald auch auf Englisch).

• Du organisierst den Content für dein Skript: UGC-Creator, Founder-Aufnahmen, B-Roll, Voiceover, Shotlisten.

• Du briefst den Cutter, gibst Feedback und nimmst ab.

• Du iterierst auf dem, was läuft: neue Hooks, neue Längen, neue Angles.

• Du führst deine eigene Pipeline vom Test bis zur Skalierung. Im Ads Manager siehst du, was sie bringt.

Qualifikation
Wir suchen jemanden, der Copy schreibt, die verkauft, und das belegen kann:

• Du hast Direct-Response-Copy geschrieben, die nachweislich Umsatz gebracht hat. Beispiele und Zahlen liegen bei dir bereit.

• Du kennst Meta-Ads im D2C- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld von innen und weißt, was ein Creative braucht, damit es verkauft.

• Idealerweise zwei Jahre Erfahrung in Creative Strategy oder Performance-Copywriting.

• Du denkst in Avataren, Awareness Stages und Mass Desires. Marketing-Psychologie ist für dich echtes Handwerk.

• KI gehört zu deinem Alltag: Research, Varianten, Struktur. Der Hook, der sitzt, kommt von dir.

• Du schreibst verkaufsstark auf Deutsch und verhandlungssicher auf Englisch.

• Du hast Bock auf Output. Viele Videos, viele Tests, viele Learnings. Und die Geduld, zu wiederholen, was funktioniert.

• Nice-to-have: Advertorials, Listicles oder eigene Media-Buying-Erfahrung.

Benefits

• Ein Account, an dem deine Arbeit sichtbar wird: rund 500.000 € Ad-Spend im Monat. Du siehst jeden Tag, was dein Skript bringt.

• Echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins: eigene Pipeline, eigene Entscheidungen.

• Klare Perspektive: Richtung Senior.

• Gehalt nach Erfahrung (nach oben offen).

• 100 % Remote innerhalb Europas.

• Flexible Arbeitszeit: Du teilst dir deinen Tag selbst ein. Was zählt, ist dein Output.

• Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung.

• Technik-Setup deiner Wahl.

• Zugang zu Corporate Benefits.

• Ehrliches Feedback, das dich schneller weiterbringt.

• Ein bis zwei Teamevents im Jahr.

Klingt das nach dir? Dann schick uns dein Portfolio.
Zeig uns Creatives und Skripte, die du geschrieben hast, gerne so viele wie möglich: für welche Marke, was dein Anteil war und was dabei rausgekommen ist (ROAS, Spend, Winrate). Geschwärzt ist völlig okay.
Praktisch: Deinen Lebenslauf lädst du unter „CV“ hoch. Alles andere (Portfolio, Zahlen, ein kurzes Wort zu dir) packst du ins Anschreiben-Feld (max. 10 MB).
Wichtig: Wir schauen zuerst auf deine Arbeitsproben. Gute Copywriter erkennt man an ihrer Copy.
Ein Bild von uns und dem Team bekommst du auf unserer Karriereseite.
Tabea und das Valkental -Team freuen sich auf dich!

We are seeking a Medical Science Liaison (MSL) for our Gastrointestinal (GI) Oncology portfolio to primarily support Signatera, our personalized, tumor-informed minimal residual disease (MRD) test. In this field-based role, you will serve as a scientific expert responsible for engaging GI oncology healthcare providers, sharing peer-reviewed clinical data, and delivering accurate information that proactively informs disease management.
At Natera , we remember there is a person behind every sample. The MSL operates with a high degree of ownership and urgency, delivering advanced genetic testing data that changes patient outcomes when timing and accuracy matter most. This role focuses on building strong scientific relationships, delivering clear and accurate clinical education, and bringing back actionable insights from the field to change the management of disease worldwide.
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Establish and maintain scientific relationships with GI oncology healthcare providers and key opinion leaders (KOLs) within a defined territory.

• Deliver accurate, balanced, and clinically relevant education on Natera ’s GI oncology molecular diagnostics and clinical data.

• Drive territory strategy quickly and adapt as Medical Affairs priorities shift.

• Identify and communicate field insights, including GI oncology treatment trends, unmet clinical needs, and competitive dynamics.

• Respond to unsolicited medical inquiries in a timely, compliant, and scientifically rigorous manner.

• Support execution of Medical Affairs initiatives, including advisory boards and medical education programs.

• Act as a subject matter expert on gastrointestinal oncology disease states, clinical data, and the broader diagnostics market.

• Partner closely with commercial and clinical teams to support patient care without compromising scientific truth.

• Take personal accountability for doing things the right way, adhering strictly to healthcare regulations and internal standards.

• Support and coordinate clinical trial and research initiatives at academic institutions and regional study sites.

• Accurately track territory engagement and document actionable clinical insights.

• Travel 60-70% across the territory for clinical engagement and conferences.

• Adapt quickly to emerging scientific and clinical needs across the GI oncology portfolio.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Advanced healthcare or scientific degree preferred (Ph.D., Pharm.D., M.D., D.N.P.), with a minimum of a Master's degree required.

• Prior Medical Affairs or MSL experience in GI oncology or molecular diagnostics preferred.

• Must reside within the assigned territory.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

• Technical expertise and the research ability to clearly explain complex genetic testing data and clinical products to GI oncology specialists.

• Experience establishing strong, collaborative working relationships with internal teams and external customers.

• Ability to work independently and remotely while maintaining a strong team-oriented work ethic.

• Navigate ambiguity effectively and take the initiative to build structure and processes where none currently exist.

• Use clear, straightforward language to communicate clinical evidence effectively without heavy jargon.

• Demonstrate flexibility and the capacity to adjust quickly to unexpected clinical tasks or strategy shifts.

• High level of personal accountability, ownership, and sound scientific judgment.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT

• This is a remote, field-based position requiring daily use of a computer and the ability to travel extensively.

• Duties require flexibility around scheduling to support evening or weekend clinical meetings when necessary.

What You’ll Work On

Clinical Trial Leadership & Site Management

title: Embedded Control Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

- Architect a breakthrough energy technology - Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

- Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion - Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

- Move fast and build what matters - Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

In this role, you will play a key part in developing the embedded control platform and will translate functional and control requirements into embedded hardware and software architectures, select appropriate microcontrollers, DSP, FPGA, or other controller technologies, and develop real-time software close to the hardware implementation. Your work will directly influence the performance, reliability, safety, and will require close collaboration with power electronics, integrated electronics, mechanical, thermal, and system engineers.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Define embedded controller architectures for power electronic converters and select suitable microcontrollers, DSP, FPGA.

- Translate power electronics and control requirements into efficient, deterministic, and robust real-time software implementations.

- Develop, test, debug, and validate embedded software on target hardware, from individual software blocks through complete controller implementations and automated testing environments to validate the design.

- Explore new controller technologies, embedded architectures, and software implementation concepts to improve converter performance, flexibility, reliability, functionality, and maintainability.

WHO YOU ARE

- You hold a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

- You have a strong understanding of embedded architectures, and the practical considerations involved in selecting controllers for demanding real-time applications.

- You are an expert in embedded software development for real-time applications, preferably in power electronics, industrial automation, or similar applications, spanning FPGA programming, systems programming, hardware interfaces and communication protocols.

- You are experienced in monitoring and debugging software directly on target hardware

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with model-based development, hardware-in-the-loop testing, automated testing, or safety-critical software development is a plus.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

- Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

- Technical Screening (30 min)

- Technical Panel (3x60 min)

title: Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we're changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK's leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We're growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we're hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We're on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

Content and events. Two engines of Flock's marketing, and you own the execution of both.

Today the marketing team is one Senior Marketing Manager, who owns the brand and website, publishes the content, launches the products and runs up to nine events a year, getting it all out of the door by pushing AI hard. We're doubling the team and backing it with 3.5x the budget.

You're the second person in, owning events and content.

Events. You'll plan the calendar with the Senior Marketing Manager and own delivery: trade shows and conferences, plus our own broker and customer events. On each one you'll set the budget, build the stand, run the day, chase the leads and report on whether it was worth repeating.

Content. You'll shape the strategy with the Senior Marketing Manager, then produce it. Volume and quality both count. LinkedIn and the Flock blog are the priorities, plus video and website copy. The stories sit with underwriting, distribution and product, so getting good material out of busy people is a big part of the job.

AI. Flock runs on AI and we build AI products for customers too. Marketing is held to the same standard. We want you to be the person who brings the newest tool into the office and shows everyone what it does. Brokers and customers still respond to work that feels human, so you'll be someone who writes excellently and still has creative flair.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Own social media. Run our social strategy, with LinkedIn as the primary channel: product videos, carousels, infographics, and PDF’s, posted consistently and measured for engagement.

- Create content at volume. Case studies, articles, industry news, thought leadership and product launch material, several times a month.

- Make video. Film and produce videos with our team in and around the office: people stories, product walkthroughs and interviews.

- Deliver events. Work with the Senior Marketing Manager Coordinate and execute our calendar of seven to nine events a year: trade shows, conferences and our own customer and broker events.

- Design your own assets in Claude Design and Figma, to a standard that holds up next to agency work.

- Work with AI daily. Draft, edit, repurpose and scale content with AI tools, applying your own voice and judgement so nothing reads machine-written.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- Significant content creation and social media experience, ideally in B2B tech, with measurable results from owning and executing a social strategy.

- A portfolio of work you can share on the spot.

- Strong copywriting and communication, proven in published work.

- A track record organising and coordinating trade shows, conferences or business events, plus internal events for customers and stakeholders.

- Hands-on design skills in Figma and Claude Design. Adobe Creative Cloud would be a bonus.

- Startup pace and ownership: you've worked somewhere small enough to own outcomes end to end, spot what needs improving and act without waiting for a brief.

- Confident, critical use of AI across your marketing work.

Nice to have: video editing experience, and exposure to insurance, fleet or telematics.

title: Implementation Lead
description:
About TJM Labs

TJM Labs is building the digital workforce for pharmacy.
Pharmacies are being asked to do more with fewer resources. Prescription volumes are growing, margins are tightening, and talented pharmacy teams spend too much of their day on repetitive operational work.
We're changing that.
TJM Labs builds AI-powered automation designed specifically for pharmacy. Our technology works within the systems pharmacies already use to automate repetitive workflows and create more capacity for pharmacists and pharmacy technicians to focus on the work that actually requires them.
We're growing quickly, and successful implementation is one of the most important parts of delivering on that promise.
That's where you come in.
About the Role
We're looking for an Implementation Lead to own the day-to-day execution of customer implementations from discovery through go-live and transition to ongoing support.
This is a hands-on role at the intersection of pharmacy operations, project management, customer communication, and technology.
You'll work in close partnership with a Customer Success Manager (CSM). The CSM owns the overall customer relationship, strategic alignment, and escalations. You own getting the implementation done.
During implementation, you'll be the hub of the project. You'll coordinate customer and internal stakeholders, document how the pharmacy operates today, translate those workflows into clear requirements, maintain the implementation plan, manage communication and action items, own internal QA, and drive the project toward a successful go-live.
You'll also own one of the most important safeguards in our implementation process: making sure what the pharmacy does, what we've documented, what we've asked our technical teams to build, and what we ultimately deliver all remain in sync.
This isn't a role where you'll simply maintain a project plan and schedule meetings.
You'll ask questions. You'll uncover exceptions. You'll document details. You'll chase down decisions. You'll test what we've built. You'll notice when something doesn't line up. You'll keep people accountable for commitments. And when a project starts drifting, you'll help get it back on course.
You don't need to be an engineer or an AI expert.
You do need to understand pharmacy operations and pharmacy management systems, be curious about technology, communicate exceptionally well, and be very good at turning complexity into clarity.
What You'll Own
1. Day-to-Day Implementation Execution
Once a customer enters implementation, you'll own the day-to-day work required to get them live.

• Establish and maintain the implementation plan, milestones, dependencies, and target go-live date.

• Lead implementation meetings, discovery sessions, and working sessions.

• Coordinate activities across the pharmacy, TJM technical teams, the CSM, and other internal stakeholders.

• Track decisions, action items, customer deliverables, risks, dependencies, and outstanding requirements.

• Follow up consistently to keep projects moving.

• Identify risks and blockers early and drive them toward resolution.

• Manage implementation changes and understand their impact on scope, requirements, and timelines.

• Keep projects on schedule and surface concerns before they become surprises.

• Coordinate go-live activities and the transition into ongoing support.

At any point in the project, you should be able to answer: What needs to happen next to get this customer live?
2. Pharmacy Process Discovery & Documentation
Before we can automate a pharmacy workflow, we need to understand exactly how that workflow operates today.
You'll own creating and maintaining clear, accurate, and highly standardized documentation of each customer's current-state pharmacy processes before TJM automation is introduced.

• Lead structured workflow discovery with pharmacy stakeholders.

• Understand how work moves through the pharmacy today - including people, pharmacy management systems, other te

title: Product Reliability Engineer
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops silicon and system-level solutions designed for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. The team is responsible for building the next generation of AI-native silicon while working closely with software and research partners to co-design hardware tightly integrated with AI models. In addition to delivering production-grade silicon for OpenAI’s supercomputing infrastructure, the team also creates custom design tools and methodologies that accelerate innovation and enable hardware optimized specifically for AI.

The Compute team works on the design of our AI supercomputers, doing everything from workload modeling to influencing accelerator design. We’re leaning into our partnerships to make system and data center co-design an integral part of this process, and are looking for engineers to design AI supercomputers solutions for data center applications

This team is responsible for working with partners to optimize their hardware for our workloads, identifying promising new deep learning accelerators, and bringing those hardware platforms to production.

If you’re excited to work at the intersection of cutting edge deep learning, hardware system, and data center design this role is for you!

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Reliability Engineer to own reliability engineering for advanced IT hardware, from printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs) through compute and networking trays, systems, and fully integrated racks. You’ll translate operating conditions and service-life goals into reliability requirements, design and execute qualification tests, and drive failure analysis and corrective-action verification from development through production and field deployment. Working with electrical, mechanical, thermal, manufacturing, quality, and data center teams, suppliers, and manufacturing partners, you’ll use test and field evidence to improve hardware durability, serviceability, and availability.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

- Define reliability requirements and targets for PCBAs, trays, systems, and racks using mission profiles, expected service life, operating environments, duty cycles, and availability goals.

- Drive design-for-reliability reviews with electrical, mechanical, and thermal engineers. Use failure modes and effects analysis (DFMEA or FMEA) and physics of failure to prioritize risks and recommend design improvements. Own component de-rating guidelines and guidance.

- Own reliability qualification plans from new product introduction through production, defining test coverage, representative configurations, sample sizes, stress conditions, duration, pass/fail criteria, and exit evidence at each assembly level.

- Develop and execute accelerated life and environmental tests, including temperature cycling, humidity exposure, power cycling, shock, vibration, and transport testing. Exercise hardware under representative workloads and monitor function and degradation during stress.

- Analyze life-test and field data using Weibull and other reliability models, acceleration models, and confidence intervals. State assumptions, exposure, and uncertainty when estimating failure rates, useful life, or reliability against targets.

- Lead failure investigations from symptom reproduction through physical root cause. Maintain failure reporting, analysis, and corrective-action records, and verify fixes through targeted testing and recurrence monitoring.

- Review supplier reliability plans and evidence for PCBs, PCBa components/assemblies, cables, connectors, and cooling components. Identify gaps between component qualification and the stresses encountered in the integrated system or rack.

You will work closely with the Security and Operations teams to keep our endpoints, offices, networks, and SaaS tools secure, while making sure people stay as productive as possible with the tools we have.

REQUIREMENTS

- Strong hands-on background in IT Engineering, Technical Operations, or a DevOps-adjacent role, with an automation-first mindset and experience managing enterprise scale IT systems

- Proven ability to maintain compliance with SOC 2 / ISO 27001

Incode is the leading provider of world-class identity solutions that is reinventing the way humans authenticate and verify their identities online to power a world of digital trust.

Through our revolutionary identity solutions, we are unleashing the business potential of universal industries including finance, government, retail, hospitality, gaming, and more, by reducing fraud and transforming human interactions with data, products, and services.

Incode is a Series B unicorn ($2 B valuation) rewriting how the world proves identity. Our AI-powered platform lets leading banks, fintechs, marketplaces, and governments deliver friction-free experiences while defeating fraud and safeguarding privacy. Build career-progression frameworks that reinforce a merit-based culture.

title: Mulesoft Developer
description:
About Leadex Systems

Leadex Systems is a niche software consulting company and a long-time MuleSoft partner. We provide best-in-class API Management solutions in the Middle East and Europe. Our team of 60 like-minded professionals combines technical expertise with domain knowledge in digital banking, finance, and e-commerce. We embrace proactiveness, continuous learning, team spirit, and commitment to customer success.
About the role
As a MuleSoft Developer, you will work collaboratively with a dynamic team of architects, project managers, and clients to design, implement, and maintain integration solutions that drive business success. This is a unique opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies in a fast-paced and exciting industry.
Responsibilities:

• Collaborate with Project Managers, Solution Architects, and stakeholders to design and implement MuleSoft APIs tailored to business needs.

• Conduct technical analyses to translate business requirements into actionable solutions.

• Create RAML Specifications to serve as API contracts during development.

• Design and develop DataWeave scripts for complex data transformation tasks.

• Apply API-Led Connectivity principles to create scalable and reusable integration layers.

• Configure and manage API policies in API Manager.

• Deploy APIs across diverse environments, including CloudHub, Runtime Fabric, and On-Premise workers.

• Enhance development processes with CI/CD pipeline automation.

Requirements:

• 2+ years of experience with MuleSoft tools such as Anypoint Studio and Anypoint Platform, including Design Center, Runtime Manager, and API Manager.

• Proven ability to understand business requirements and implement complex integrations.

• Expertise in designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise-level solutions to meet complex business needs.

• Strong knowledge of Enterprise Integration Patterns and API design best practices for REST and RPC.

• Familiarity with Microservices architecture, including its benefits and trade-offs compared to traditional SOA.

• Proficiency in English (B2 or higher), with strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Experience working in geographically distributed teams using Agile methodologies.

• 3+ years of hands-on experience in OOP development/design.

• Expertise in profiling and troubleshooting Java applications.

• Knowledge of Linux container technologies such as Docker or rkt and orchestration platforms like Kubernetes or OpenShift.

• Experience with SSO/IDM tools (e.g., Keycloak, ForgeRock, Okta, Auth0).

• Familiarity with messaging systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Apache ActiveMQ, ZeroMQ).

• Advanced user knowledge of Linux/Unix-like systems.

• Hands-on experience in DevOps automation tools (e.g., Jenkins, TeamCity, Bamboo) and monitoring tools (e.g., Prometheus, Zabbix).

We offer:

• An exciting project with on-the-edge technology in one of the most dynamic industries.

• A community of professionals to work and have fun together.

• Flexibility in terms of location to work from: we consider applicants from all locations.

• Flexible work schedule.

• 31 days of vacation.

• 5 sick days.

Let's get to know each other!

title: SAP Extension Developer
description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States. This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: SAP Extension Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000-$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP Extension Developer to design, build, and operate extensions, side-by-side applications, and integration scenarios on SAP’s Business Technology Platform. In this role you will leverage BTP services across application development, integration, data and analytics, and AI to deliver clean-core extensions of SAP S/4HANA and other SAP applications.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of SAP development experience, with significant hands-on work on SAP BTP.

• Strong experience with the SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP) in Node.js and/or Java.

• Hands-on experience with SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 development.

• Solid experience with OData v2/v4 service design and consumption.

• Experience with BTP runtimes (Cloud Foundry and/or Kyma) and BTP services.

• Working knowledge of XSUAA, SAP IAS, and SAP IPS.

• Familiarity with CI/CD patterns and tooling for BTP.

• Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA extension patterns and clean-core principles.

Preferred Qualifications

• SAP-certified BTP developer credentials.

• Experience with SAP Build, Workflow, Business Rules, or Document Management Service.

• Exposure to SAP AI Core and integration with hyperscaler AI services.

• Familiarity with SAP Integration Suite / CPI.

• Experience with multi-tenant SaaS applications on BTP.

How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 505-3545. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.

title: Head of Supply
description:
Social Discovery Group (SDG) is a group of social discovery companies. SDG solves the problems of loneliness, isolation, and disconnection - transforming virtual intimacy into the new normal. SDG’s products redefine the way people interact and connect with one another.

Our portfolio includes social entertainment platforms designed to connect people online across different cultures and regions of the world.

We bring together a team of like-minded people and IT professionals who specialize in creating and developing globally impactful social discovery products. Our international team of digital nomads works remotely from all over the world.

We’re proud to be a two-time “Great Place to Work” winner (USA & Japan, 2024-2025) and a Top-5 Company for Work-From-Anywhere Jobs (FlexJobs, 2025).

We are looking for Head of Supply .

Your main tasks will be:

• Own the supply side of a two-sided marketplace: keep demand covered by quality, available supply at a sustainable cost.

• Build the supply planning system: demand forecasting, a sufficiency model and partner order plans, with control over how they're carried out.

• Manage the supply-demand balance across segments, time slots and formats, separating registered supply from available supply.

• Lead three areas: Partner Support (automation), Partners Development & Growth (mid-size partners) and Key Partners Success (top 50).

• Design partner economics and incentives: payouts, commissions, bonuses and the Bronze → Silver → Gold → Platinum tier system, with safeguards against gaming the rules.

• Own quality and trust: tie partner communication quality to customer retention and stop harmful practices.

• Drive change from hypothesis to pilot to scaled process, working with analytics and product on cohorts and control groups.

We expect from you:

• Supply/demand analysis by segment, time slot and format, including setting forecasting tasks for analysts.

• Partner unit economics: payouts, cost to serve, payback, revenue split.

• Incentive design: commissions, bonuses, rules and anti-gaming mechanisms.

• Experience running partner tier systems and the economics of moving partners up the tiers.

• Partner segmentation, account management and development planning.

• Operational management: SLAs, quality standards, deviation analysis, process automation.

• Experiment design and impact measurement: cohorts, control groups, and separating the effect of your own decisions from traffic or product changes.

Director, Market Access & Reimbursement Strategy
description:
Saluda Medical is a commercial‑stage medical device company focused on developing treatments for chronic neurological conditions using its novel closed‑loop neuromodulation platform. The company’s proprietary technology senses and measures neural responses to stimulation and automatically adjusts therapy based on real‑time neurophysiological feedback.
Saluda Medical ’s first product, the Evoke® System, is designed to deliver known, consistent, and personalized spinal cord stimulation therapy by objectively measuring neural responses and maintaining therapy within a prescribed therapeutic window. Saluda Medical is headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota.
At Saluda, we challenge boundaries. We innovate and think beyond the conventional. Our focus is to revolutionize the standard of care in neuromodulation to positively impact patient’s lives.
The Director of Market Access & Reimbursement Strategy will lead Saluda's U.S. market access, coverage, and reimbursement strategy, with direct ownership of the Smart Access Reimbursement program. This leader will ensure patients and providers have a clear, reliable path to therapy access from prior authorization through payment, while building the payer strategies, evidence narratives, and value-based contracting frameworks that position Saluda's closed-loop technology for long-term commercial success.
This is a high-visibility role reporting to the VP of Marketing, working cross-functionally with Sales, Clinical, Regulatory, and Finance, and engaging directly with payers, providers, and policy stakeholders.
What You’ll Do:
Smart Access Reimbursement Program

• Own, manage, and continuously improve the Smart Access Reimbursement program, including prior authorization support, appeals strategy, benefit investigation, and case escalation pathways

• Define program KPIs (approval rates, turnaround times, denial overturn rates) and report performance to commercial leadership

• Manage vendor and hub-services relationships supporting the program; ensure field teams and provider offices are trained and supported

• Serve as the escalation point for complex access cases and emerging payer barriers

Payer & Reimbursement Strategy

• Develop and execute national and regional payer strategies to establish, maintain, and expand coverage for SCS and closed-loop therapy

• Monitor and shape coding, coverage, and payment dynamics (CPT/HCPCS, DRG/APC, physician fee schedule) across commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid channels

• Track and respond to CMS policy developments, including the Ambulatory Specialty Model (ASM) and other value-based initiatives affecting the chronic pain and neuromodulation space

• Lead development of value-based and shared-risk contracting frameworks that leverage Evoke's objective ECAP data as a differentiator

Evidence & Value Communication

• Lead the translation of clinical and real-world evidence into payer-facing value dossiers, objection handlers, and coverage advocacy materials

• Support medical policy engagement, including responses to draft policies, technology assessments, and payer advisory interactions

• Build and manage relationships with relevant medical societies (e.g., NANS, INS, ASPN, ASIPP) to advance coverage advocacy, coding initiatives, and clinical guideline development supporting SCS access

• Equip Sales and field reimbursement resources with tools, training, and messaging to navigate access conversations confidently

Cross-Functional & Team Leadership

• Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, and Therapy Awareness teams to integrate access messaging into commercial campaigns and launch plans

• Build and mentor market access talent as the function scales; manage direct reports and/or contracted field reimbursement resources as assigned

• Represent Saluda with professional societies, coalitions, and industry groups on reimbursement and policy matters
